Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Thank you for outlining your cost structure; we are seeking a materially lower fixed unit price in return for a longer contract commitment. Please send your cost-breakdown workbook in XLSX format so we can reconcile the material component with the recent alloy-index trend. We can consider retaining your proposed payment terms as part of that package.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -0.3% from 2026-03 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.77 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume, which allows us to offer a more favorable base price. However, for a contract of this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility. While our policy prohibits sharing internal cost breakdowns, we can offer €5.60 per unit under these terms; please provide documentation for the alternative quotes you referenced. Please send us the competing offer you mentioned. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

We recognise the value you place on a longer contract and your stated requirement for an index clause. Our counterproposal nevertheless seeks a lower fixed unit price, with earlier payment available in exchange for a further price concession. We can substantiate our purchase-price history for this discussion, but that evidence should not be confused with a competing quotation.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.84 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.86 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Thank you for confirming the price history; our contractual commitment and earlier payment should translate into a lower base price. Please send your cost-breakdown workbook in XLSX format so we can examine the material component against the index, and clarify why your earlier-payment option carries a higher price despite the stated concession. We note your requirement to retain indexation, but any such protection must be matched by a lower base price and a meaningful deadband.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.99 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 5.01 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so please decide. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

As an alternative, we must retain the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract, but we can offer a reduced base price of €5.20 per unit with 14-day payment terms, alongside a contract term of 24 months and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We have corrected our pricing for the 14-day payment term to properly reflect the value of earlier payment.

Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. As previously stated, our policy prohibits sharing internal cost breakdowns; please provide the specific data or calculations that support your target base price. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Thank you for clarifying your final offer and correcting the base price to reflect earlier payment. While we acknowledge your confidentiality policy, please provide a shareable XLSX calculation showing how the material component and proposed index clause support the base price, without disclosing confidential internal details. Against the proposed contract term, please consider a final modest base-price reduction within your approval authority so we can bring the discussion to a close.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months.

We accept your alternative as you proposed it; it is attached as a term sheet for your confirmation.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
